title: Travel English Conversation: At the Airport Check-in | Unit 2 of the Travel English Speaking Series

lines.en: Good morning, sir.
Can I see your passport, please?
Yes, here it is.
Thank you, Mr. Smith.
Thanks for flying with us.
Is this your first time going to Tokyo?
Yes, it is. I'm going for Christmas.
That's exciting!
How long will you stay in Tokyo?
I'll be there for a week.
lines.ko: 나는 일주일 동안 거기에 있을 것이다.

lines.en: Great. How many suitcases are you checking in?
Just one suitcase.
Perfect.
If you could place it on the scale for me, that would be great.
lines.ko: 저를 위해 저울에 올려주시면 정말 좋을 것 같아요.

lines.en: Sure.
Thank you.
Hmm... it seems that your bag is a bit too heavy.
lines.ko: 흠... 가방이 좀 무거운 것 같군요.

lines.en: It is over our weight requirement.
lines.ko: 그것은 우리의 무게 요구 사항을 초과했습니다.

lines.en: Oh no, what should I do?
Would you like to take something out of your suitcase
and put in your carry-on bag?
Yes! I'll take this big book out of the bag.
lines.ko: ? 예! 가방에서 이 큰 책을 꺼낼게요.

lines.en: Great.
Do you have any electronics in your carry-on bag?
I have a laptop in my carry-on.
Is that okay?
Yes, that's fine.
Just make sure you can easily take it out during the security check.
lines.ko: 보안 검색대에서 쉽게 꺼낼 수 있는지 확인하세요.

lines.en: I'll put it in a separate pocket for easy access.
lines.ko: 쉽게 꺼낼 수 있도록 별도의 주머니에 넣어두겠습니다.

lines.en: Good idea.
According to the information,
you have booked a window seat.
Is it still okay for you?
Yes, I would like a window seat.
I want to see the view.
Great choice.
Okay, let me print your boarding pass.
Thank you.
Here is your seat number and the departure gate.
lines.ko: 좌석 번호와 출발 게이트는 다음과 같습니다.

lines.en: Thank you. When does boarding start?
Boarding starts at 7.
It's recommended to be at the gate 1 hour before departure.
lines.ko: 출발 1시간 전에 게이트에 도착하는 것을 권장합니다.

lines.en: And how do I get to the gate?
You will turn right at the coffee shop.
Security will be directly in front of you.
lines.ko: 보안이 바로 여러분 앞에 있을 것입니다.

lines.en: Once you are finished clearing security,
follow the signs to Gate 32.
Okay, thank you for your help.
I'm really excited about my trip to Tokyo.
You're welcome, Mr. Smith.
Enjoy your holiday in Tokyo.
Have a safe and happy journey!
